entries.mem0ai/mem0: An official Hermes Agent memory provider that offers a universal memory layer with multi-level support for user, session, and agent states. It features temporal reasoning and multi-signal retrieval, available as an Apache-2.0 self-hosted server or managed cloud.
entries.volcengine/OpenViking: This official Hermes Agent provider organizes context as a virtual filesystem using viking:// URIs and a tiered L0/L1/L2 loading system. It is designed to reduce token consumption by 91% and provides observable retrieval trajectories for debugging context paths.
entries.topoteretes/cognee: A self-hosted knowledge graph engine that provides agents with persistent long-term memory across multiple sessions. It builds these graphs from text and code data and supports Python 3.10–3.14 for local or cloud deployment.
entries.garrytan/gbrain: This agent brain extracts typed entity edges without LLM calls and features a 24/7 daemon for autonomous memory consolidation. It supports multi-user data scoping and utilizes privacy-verified local storage for data management.
entries.supermemoryai/supermemory: An official Hermes Agent provider that utilizes a custom vector graph engine to sustain sub-300ms recall at scales exceeding 100B tokens per month. It features automated fact extraction, byte-level deduplication, and connectors for platforms like Google Drive, Notion, and GitHub.
entries.vectorize-io/hindsight: A memory system focused on long-term retain, recall, and reflect workflows that learns over time. It supports over 25 LLM providers and offers deployment options ranging from local Docker and Kubernetes to managed cloud environments.
entries.plastic-labs/honcho: The upstream library for the Hermes self-hosted wrapper, this FastAPI-based service provides a framework for building stateful agents. It includes Python and TypeScript SDKs to manage sessions and peer relationships across managed or local deployments.
entries.campfirein/byterover-cli: An official Hermes Agent provider that manages memory as a git-like repository with version control features like commit, branch, and merge. It utilizes a 5-tier retrieval system where four tiers are non-LLM based, achieving sub-100ms response times.
entries.mnemosyne-oss/mnemosyne: A zero-dependency memory system for Hermes Agents that uses episodic compression to achieve sub-linear storage growth. It provides sub-millisecond performance and supports the Model Context Protocol (MCP) for integration with tools like Cursor and Claude Code.
entries.ClaudioDrews/memory-os: A seven-layer memory system for Hermes Agent that integrates vector search, structured facts, and an auto-curated wiki. It relies on local infrastructure including Qdrant and Redis, using a Ground Truth hierarchy to prioritize injected context.
entries.greyhaven-ai/autocontext: A recursive self-improving context harness that produces filesystem-first artifacts such as traces and playbooks. It features outcome-gated promotion and ablation-backed attribution to refine context changes for complex tasks.
entries.stephenschoettler/hermes-lcm: A Lossless Context Management plugin for Hermes Agent that uses a SQLite-backed hierarchical DAG to ensure no messages are lost. It provides specialized recall tools like lcm_grep and lcm_recall for precise detail recovery.
entries.vshulcz/deja-vu: This tool indexes local session history from 23 different coding agents to enable millisecond lookups over months of past data. It processes up to 5 GB of historical data while automatically redacting keys and tokens during the indexing process.
entries.elkimek/honcho-self-hosted: This self-hosted backend provides private cross-session memory for Hermes Agent using a Docker-based stack including PostgreSQL and Redis. It is designed for portability, supporting any OpenAI-compatible LLM provider or local inference servers.
entries.Signet-AI/signetai: Signet-AI offers a local-first identity and memory layer that achieves 97.6% answer accuracy on LongMemEval benchmarks. It supports real-time ingestion from GitHub, Discord, and Obsidian to provide portable state across Hermes Agent and other MCP clients.
entries.plur-ai/plur: This shared memory layer utilizes a human-readable YAML format for storing engrams on local disk. It employs a hybrid search strategy combining BM25 and local embeddings to facilitate retrieval for multi-agent systems.
entries.yoloshii/ClawMem: ClawMem is an on-device context engine that operates locally without cloud dependencies or API keys. It integrates via MCP and plugins, using a combination of vector search and BM25 for hybrid information retrieval.
entries.Sibyl-Labs/Sibyl-Memory: This file-based long-term memory system uses SQLite with FTS5 search instead of vector databases or embeddings. It features a five-package plugin family that includes a dedicated Hermes adapter and a LangGraph BaseStore.
entries.EfficientContext/ContextPilot: ContextPilot optimizes context through block reordering and deduplication to save up to 36% in tokens and reduce prefill latency by 1.5–3×. It provides native plugin support for the Hermes Agent and OpenClaw ecosystems to accelerate long-context inference.
entries.yantrikos/yantrikdb-hermes-plugin: This plugin provides explainable recall by attaching 'why_retrieved' tags to every result and includes a self-directing loop to resolve knowledge gaps. It supports owner-scoping for multi-user environments and features contradiction tracking and recency ranking.
entries.ccf/agentcairn: AgentCairn uses an Obsidian vault as a source of truth, storing long-term memory as inspectable Markdown files. It runs locally without a daemon or telemetry, utilizing DuckDB as a replaceable retrieval cache.
entries.yepyhun/Brainstack: Brainstack is a memory kernel stack that integrates Hindsight, Graphiti, and MemPalace into a single owner for Hermes Agent. It manages state and retrieval using SQLite, Kuzu, and Chroma to deliver purpose-built evidence packets per query.
entries.amanning3390/flowstate-qmd: This anticipatory memory system prefetches context by monitoring agent session logs using SQLite-vec and GGUF models. It is an MCP-native server designed for automated configuration with major coding agent clients.
entries.Perseus-Computing-LLC/perseus: Perseus resolves live workspace state into verified facts before the context window opens, aiming for a 94% reduction in prompt tokens. It uses a local-first architecture with SQLite and FTS5, supporting both stdio and SSE via the Model Context Protocol.
entries.generalbusiness-ai/keep: This provider enables reflective memory through semantic search that combines BM25 full-text indexing with ranked graph traversal. It automates indexing for codebases and multimedia via OCR, using edge tags to establish navigable, bidirectional relationships between stored notes.
entries.alias8818/hermes-tool-slimmer: Compatible with Hermes Agent v0.14.0, this tool reduces prompt token overhead by using local BM25 ranking to select relevant tool schemas. It includes a dedicated dashboard for monitoring estimated token savings and supports native tool search functionality.
entries.conorbronsdon/claude-context-os: This Git-backed layer manages identity, decisions, and workflows for coding agents using plain Markdown files. It facilitates a source-neutral migration workflow for documents and chats across supported agents like Claude Code and Codex.
entries.Ladybug-Memory/hermes-memory-plugin: This local-only plugin utilizes a single .lbdb embedded graph database to store memories with built-in 1-10 importance ranking. It prioritizes high-value information during context prefetch using BM25 keyword search and optional GLiNER2 entity extraction.
entries.MukundaKatta/hermes-agentmemory: A pull-model episodic memory plugin that features immediate event deletion and an on-demand summarizer to prevent persistent summaries from affecting future recall. It provides a trace.jsonl audit log to track every prefetch and memory operation.
entries.piprail/piprail: This SDK and MCP server enables agents to handle payments across 29 chains, including EVM and Solana, using USDC and other stablecoins. It integrates with Hermes to allow agents to pay for APIs or charge for their own services with 0% transaction fees.
entries.stepanov1975/hermes-local-knowledge: This plugin indexes local skills, runbooks, and MCP server configurations to facilitate capability routing. It provides five native tools for search and retrieval, using model calls to automatically generate routing notes for local scripts.
entries.yonro/hermes-xmemo-plugin: This provider offers durable cross-session memory by combining pre-turn context injection with session-end snapshots. It utilizes a local SQLite reliability layer and a write outbox to manage tools for searching, remembering, and updating agent state.
entries.futurebrowser/hermes-exabase-plugin: Integrating Exabase M-1, this plugin provides self-organizing long-term memory with support for configurable query expansion and result reranking. It includes specific tools for both manual memory storage and automated retrieval.
entries.sourcevault-ai/sourcevault-code-tools: This plugin provides private local code memory for repositories, requiring a local SourceVault server for indexing and vector storage. it adds deterministic slash commands and LLM-callable tools for semantic search, file reads, and grounded Q&A.
entries.visorcraft/MongrelDB-Hermes: An AI-native memory solution that defaults to AES-256-GCM encryption at rest and supports HNSW ANN, sparse, and FM-index retrieval. It can be executed via native Rust FFI or as an HTTP daemon, offering metadata filters and MinHash deduplication.
entries.penfieldlabs/hermes-penfield: This provider features 17 tools for memory management and knowledge graph traversal using a hybrid of BM25, vector, and graph search methods. It also performs automatic context checkpointing during the message compression process.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-memory-kit: This toolkit provides a file-based curation loop that identifies data rot and contradictions within a git-backed directory of markdown files. It features five slash commands for memory capture and recall, utilizing specialized curators to propose evidence-cited diffs for manual review.

entries.obra/superpowers: This framework implements a subagent-driven development process to facilitate autonomous task execution. It belongs in this list for its ability to enforce test-driven development and YAGNI principles while integrating as a plugin for various coding harnesses.
entries.nexu-io/open-design: This local-first system enables the generation of prototypes, decks, and documents using real CSS and components. It is included for its native support of Hermes Agent and its compatibility with DeepSeek Harness, Claude Code, and OpenAI-compatible endpoints.
entries.mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills: This project provides 818 structured skills across 34 security domains, mapped to frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK, ATLAS, and NIST AI RMF. It serves as a comprehensive security knowledge base compatible with over 26 AI platforms.
entries.Agents365-ai/drawio-skill: This skill converts natural language, SQL, and IaC into .drawio diagrams while preserving manual layout adjustments. It adds value by enforcing architecture contracts through YAML/JSON rules and a Diagram-as-Test methodology.
entries.internet-court/internet-court-skill: Acting as a trust layer for agent-to-agent commerce, this project provides a master router and connector skills for delegated permissions and payments. It belongs here for adding a verification and dispute resolution layer to agent interactions.
entries.conorbronsdon/avoid-ai-writing: This tool audits and rewrites content to eliminate detectable AI patterns using a 112-entry word replacement table. It is a relevant skill for Hermes agents requiring rewrite, detect-only, or edit-in-place capabilities.
entries.AMAP-ML/SkillClaw: This project unifies isolated skill silos into a shared, evolving library that natively integrates with Hermes and OpenClaw. It includes a bilingual dashboard for inspecting skills and session traces to support collective skill evolution.
entries.wondelai/skills: This cross-platform library provides 51 expert frameworks and 14 guided metaskills compatible with agent-plugins.org specifications. It is designed to maintain session state within a project's documentation directory for persistent agent workflows.
entries.mohitagw15856/pm-claude-skills: This collection features 1,169 skills for professional and life tasks that run natively in Hermes Agent. The skills are distributed as plain markdown files, making them easily portable and ready for immediate export.
entries.ZeroPointRepo/youtube-skills: This skill set enables Hermes Agent to perform video searches, browse channels, and extract transcripts or playlists. It expands agent utility by providing structured access to YouTube data via a dedicated API.
entries.Romanescu11/hermes-skill-factory: This meta-skill plugin automatically detects reusable patterns in active workflows to propose new skills. It streamlines development by generating both SKILL.md documentation and Python plugin scaffolds via slash commands.
entries.Cranot/super-hermes: This project teaches Hermes Agent to write its own custom thinking instructions and analytical prompts for specific tasks. It enhances agent performance by providing pre-built analytical lenses and reporting on potential analysis blind spots.
entries.DougTrajano/pydantic-ai-skills: This project provides type-safe support for agentskills.io using Pydantic AI, enabling remote skill registries via Git and S3. It includes tools for reading bundled resources and executing scripts within a sandboxed environment to isolate untrusted code from the host.
entries.AkoliteZA/hermes-agent-idea-workflow: This skill set automates the transition from rough concepts to structured design and implementation documents through Lite and Full complexity modes. It features a specialized spec review gate that utilizes PASS/FAIL evaluation models to ensure project readiness.
entries.tlehman/litprog-skill: This literate programming skill allows agents to generate .lit.md files that combine prose, diagrams, and source code. It includes a tangler for extracting runnable files and automatically synchronizes source edits back into the primary literate document.
entries.ReinaMacCredy/maestro: Designed for long-running agents, this harness uses a mechanism kernel and Markdown-based recipes to manage work trees and immutable decision records. It implements the SLP cooperative-agent protocol to facilitate supervised team generations and cross-role handbacks.
entries.esaradev/icarus-plugin: This plugin enables cross-instance shared memory via markdown files to capture high-value decisions and outcomes. It establishes a pipeline for fine-tuning and transitioning tasks to replacement models based on recorded work history.
entries.smartcontractkit/chainlink-agent-skills: Following the Agent Skills specification, this project provides specialized tools for interacting with CCIP, VRF, and Data Feeds. It enables agents to integrate directly with oracle networks and specialized services like CRE and ACE.
entries.Hermes-brasil/hermes-brasil: This community-driven repository offers Hermes Agent skills, installation guides, and configurations specifically localized in Portuguese. All provided skills adhere to the SKILL.md format and the agentskills.io standard.
entries.black-forest-labs/skills: These official skills provide specialized prompting guidelines and API integration for FLUX 3 video and image generation. The project includes a router to manage multi-step video workflows via Python and TypeScript clients.
entries.armelhbobdad/bmad-module-skill-forge: This tool converts repositories, documentation, and developer discourse into version-pinned, agentskills.io-compliant instruction files. It links instructions directly to source lines or URLs and includes a full lifecycle for creating, testing, and exporting skills.
entries.chigwell/skilldock.io: This registry facilitates the discovery and installation of reusable AI skills with built-in recursive dependency resolution. It features a Python client and CLI, alongside commerce capabilities powered by TON payments.
entries.tiann/execplan-skill: Focused on autonomous execution, this skill manages complex multi-step tasks with real-time progress tracking and decision logging. It includes built-in rollback procedures to ensure safe recovery during long-running operations.
entries.supernovae-st/nika: This local-first workflow language uses a Rust binary and four core verbs—infer, invoke, exec, and agent—to define intent as code. It executes tasks as a dependency graph with parallel processing and maintains local journals for auditability.
entries.adnw-vinc/hermes-nextcloud: This skill enables Hermes Agent to manage files, notes, calendars, tasks, and contacts through standard WebDAV and CalDAV protocols. It ensures secure communication via HTTPS using Nextcloud App Passwords and includes a guided script for credential validation.
entries.cablate/Agentic-MCP-Skill: This progressive MCP client utilizes a three-layer lazy loading architecture to minimize token usage during agent interactions. It features a socket-based daemon for persistent connections and supports incremental discovery of server metadata and tool schemas.
entries.willingning-coder/eagle-eye: Eagle-eye provides a five-layer intelligent retrieval system that uses hard triggers and semantic embeddings to narrow skill lists before LLM calls. The system is designed for efficiency and features graceful degradation if embedding models or specific dependencies are unavailable.
entries.amanning3390/hermeshub: Serving as a community hub for skill discovery and one-click installation, this project fully implements the Agentic Resource Discovery (ARD) v0.9 specification. It operates autonomously on NVIDIA infrastructure and provides federated search across GitHub and Hugging Face.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermaguard: This read-only security skill employs three parallel subagents to conduct adversarial code reviews and identify edge cases. It combines deterministic pre-scans using tools like Semgrep and Bandit with verified findings through proof-of-concept execution in a hardened sandbox.
entries.EntangledQuantum/Life_OS: Life_OS is an ADHD-friendly execution system that uses MCP connections for agent-driven scheduling and system design. It stores all data locally in a single SQLite file and includes both a React web application and an Expo-based Android app.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-multichannel-prompt-opt: This plugin optimizes Hermes Agent prompts across multiple surfaces like CLI, Discord, and Telegram, reducing token usage by 20–80%. it supports 97 languages and evaluates prompt quality across five distinct dimensions.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-simplify-swarm: Inspired by Claude Code, this skill uses a swarm of three sub-agents focused on hygiene, clarity, and correctness to simplify code. It supports five major programming languages and includes a tiered application process with a mandatory approval gate.
entries.teixeirazeus/fablize-for-hermes: This project implements a systematic investigation protocol for causal debugging and reproduction through multi-story task decomposition. It features mandatory evidence-based verification gates and a Python goal engine for managing persistent task states.
entries.PederHP/skillsdotnet: This C# and .NET implementation of the agentskills.io pattern integrates with Microsoft.Extensions.AI for tool-based skill loading. It supports the automatic registration of skill directories and utilizes SKILL.md files for progressive disclosure.
entries.handnewb/hermes-cybersec-lab: This turnkey cybersecurity lab provides Hermes Agent with over 2,000 skills and 131 tools for forensics, network analysis, and exploitation. It integrates 28 different frameworks and standards, including MITRE ATT&CK and OWASP, to handle real-world CVEs.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skills: These production-tested skills add session management and worktree recovery capabilities to provide memory between agent conversations. The toolkit also orchestrates parallel subagents for architectural reviews and includes utilities for detecting state drift.
entries.conorbronsdon/demo-gif-skill: This skill automates the creation of reproducible repository demonstrations using vhs or Playwright. It optimizes GIF files to remain under 8 MB and embeds the final rendered output directly into the project's README.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skill-builder: This tool generates Claude Code and portable agent skills from plain language while preventing technical drift. It validates skills against runtime-specific profiles and monitors official frontmatter specifications to ensure long-term compatibility.
entries.Carlo1911/skill-evolution: This project establishes a self-improvement loop by analyzing session history to identify and propose new skill coverage gaps. It uses a local evaluation framework involving LLM-judges and regression testing to gate the application of skill updates.
entries.Diabloluo/hermes-hud: This local-first dashboard provides real-time observability for Hermes Agent across 11 monitoring tabs, including token costs and error tracking. It operates with zero outbound telemetry and includes an optional script for incident alerts via Telegram and Feishu.
entries.aidevelopers2/remoteopenclaw-mcp: This CLI and MCP server enables agents to search a database of over 13,870 MCP servers and 4,384 skills. It provides direct installation commands for discovered tools and integrates with MCP-compatible clients like Hermes and Cursor.
entries.CorsenAI/hermes-windows-runtime-skills: This skill set manages environment-specific path routing and Python interpreter selection for Windows, Git Bash, and WSL. It ensures deterministic file operations and verifies project-compatible runtimes without requiring new installations.
entries.mag3nt-com/openclaw-skill: This skill automates USDC payments for HTTP 402 responses across multiple protocols including Pay Link and x402. It is designed for compatibility with the agentskills.io standard and the Hermes Agent environment.
entries.skillseal/skillseal: This project provides a functional quality seal by testing agent skills for structure, functionality, and security within isolated Docker containers. It issues cryptographically verifiable Ed25519 certificates to confirm that a skill works as intended.
entries.webmilmind1/hermes-bounty-board: This plugin allows users to earn USDC on the Base network by answering support bounties without requiring accounts or API keys. It includes tools for creating bounty boards, buying context, and settling payments directly to wallets.
entries.scavio-ai/hermes-agent: This project provides access to structured web data across 31 platforms through an MCP server exposing 191 tools. It includes five production-grade workflow skills compatible with Hermes, Claude, and OpenHands.
entries.Shine8592/china-briefing: This skill generates multi-scale Chinese news reports ranging from global to street-level perspectives. It utilizes semantic memory to align search results with user interests and produces structured summaries with specific action suggestions.
entries.jiawood2006/hermes-skills: This collection provides specialized tools for Douyin video transcription, document OCR, and e-commerce material generation. It also features a rule-based engine designed to remove machine-like phrasing from AI-generated text.

entries.numtide/llm-agents.nix: This project provides Nix packages for AI coding agents, including Hermes, that are automatically updated on a daily basis. It offers a reliable way to manage development tools and agent binaries, covering both open-source and proprietary software.
entries.marshallrichards/ClawPhone: This repository provides automated installers and configuration guides for running agent CLIs on ARM64 Android devices via Termux. It enables hardware and UI access through Termux:API and Termux:GUI, specifically supporting the Antigravity CLI and OpenClaw.
entries.AbuZar-Ansarii/Hermes-Agent-On-Android: This project features a one-line installation script for deploying Hermes Agent within Termux environments on Android. It supports over 70 tools and persistent memory, allowing the agent to work with local models via Ollama or external providers.
entries.ultraworkers/hermes-agent-helm-chart: This community Helm chart facilitates the deployment of Hermes Agent on Kubernetes with a focus on single-writer state safety for persistent storage. It supports both direct deployments and operator-ready workflows, including optional API and webhook listeners.
entries.amirghm/hermes-agent-mobile: This one-command installer brings Hermes to both Android and iOS devices using Termux and iSH. It integrates with Telegram for voice and file messaging and supports scheduled tasks through cron jobs on mobile platforms.
entries.TheAiSingularity/hermesclaw: This project provides a sandboxed environment for Hermes Agent using hardware-level enforcement via NVIDIA OpenShell. It implements kernel-level restrictions on network and filesystem access alongside configurable security policies for web search and messaging.
entries.solomon2773/nora: Nora is a self-hosted control plane for deploying and monitoring Hermes agents across Docker and Kubernetes using Helm charts. It features a 69-entry credential catalog, 17+ LLM provider integrations, and mandatory AES-256-GCM encryption for secrets.
entries.xmbshwll/hermes-agent-docker: This repository offers a simple Docker sandbox image that includes official Hermes installation and mini-swe-agent. It supports persistent state through mounted home directories and allows users to build specific Hermes tags using build arguments.
entries.0xrsydn/nix-hermes-agent: This project provides a Nix package and NixOS module for declarative and reproducible Hermes deployments. It manages secrets via sops-nix and supports a hybrid skill management system that combines Nix-managed and CLI-installed skills.
entries.jpalmae/hermeshq: HermesHQ is a Docker-first control plane designed to operate multiple Hermes Agent instances from a single web application. It features RBAC-controlled access, hierarchy-aware inter-agent delegation, and enterprise MCP access for external AI clients.
entries.JackTheGit/hermes-autonomous-server: This project enables headless, production-ready deployments on Ubuntu and Debian servers by configuring Hermes Gateway as a reboot-safe systemd service. It is designed for autonomous execution of recurring AI cron jobs and integrates with Nous Portal.
entries.MilkyWay008/Hermes-OTG: Hermes OTG is a portable distribution that runs from USB drives without requiring host installation or registry writes. It bundles Python 3.12 and rescue tools, supporting Desktop, TUI, and Gateway modes within isolated data environments.

entries.TauricResearch/TradingAgents: This framework deploys specialized agents for fundamental, sentiment, and technical financial analysis. It utilizes a researcher team to conduct bullish and bearish debates, overseen by risk management and portfolio manager agents for final approvals.
entries.builderz-labs/mission-control: This self-hosted orchestration platform governs agent registration, memory browsing, and cost tracking across Web UI, CLI, and REST API interfaces. It supports multi-agent workflows and can be installed locally via Node.js or deployed using Docker.
entries.agent-of-empires/agent-of-empires: This control surface manages multiple coding agents, including Hermes Agent, through TUI and web dashboards. It ensures persistent sessions via tmux integration and provides sandboxing through Docker, Podman, and Apple Containers.
entries.CryptoDmitry/hermes-agent-control-room: This execution engine manages Hermes agents and specialist teams using the Claude-style MCP protocol in stdio mode. It is the first MCP engine on the Solana blockchain and features HTTP signal detection to handle payment-required states for APIs.
entries.shannhk/hermes-agent-control-room: This template uses a level-based architecture and task bus pattern to scale Hermes Agent from single VPS instances to automated teams. It includes bundled skills for specialized operations such as security auditing, backup management, and VPS provisioning.
entries.swarmclawai/swarmclaw: This framework builds autonomous agent swarms with durable memory and MCP tool integration across more than 23 LLM providers. It features visual org charts to help users manage agent team delegation and orchestration.
entries.agent37-platform/minions: This mission control interface allows users to supervise autonomous Hermes Agent work through a centralized Kanban board and review queue. It provides live streaming of agent reasoning and requires human-in-the-loop verification for all proposed task completions.
entries.1ilkhamov/opencode-hermes-multiagent: This project coordinates 17 specialized AI agents focused on research, planning, implementation, quality, and infrastructure. It utilizes a strict pipeline architecture managed by a Master Orchestrator for precise routing and coordination.
entries.linke-ai/hermes-agent-team: This local collaboration system orchestrates Leader and Specialist agents using MCP and ACP protocols for tool and communication handling. It features a real-time Web UI for monitoring agent dialogues and task flows via Hermes Kanban.
entries.howdymary/hermes-agent-metaharness: This meta-harness automates the outer-loop optimization of benchmark code for Hermes Agent. It orchestrates TBLite and TerminalBench-2 evaluations while providing structured candidate mutation and frontier tracking.
entries.runtimenoteslabs/gladiator: This agent-vs-agent arena orchestrates nine autonomous agents across two competing AI companies. It uses Paperclip and Hermes Agent for task execution and learning, visualized through a real-time dashboard and scoreboard.
entries.InfiniteWhispers/HermesAgent-MultiModel: This fully-local framework implements a Mixture-of-Agents stack optimized for consumer GPUs like the RTX 4080/5080. It uses Hermes for task routing and tool-calling while performing parallel model querying and synthesis via Ollama.

entries.colbymchenry/codegraph: This tool maintains a local, pre-indexed code knowledge graph that automatically synchronizes with file changes to reduce token usage and tool calls. It provides structural extraction for languages like TypeScript and Python, integrating directly with agents such as Hermes and Claude Code.
entries.junhoyeo/tokscale: A CLI tool that tracks token consumption across multiple AI coding agents and CLI tools, including Hermes and Gemini. It features a Terminal User Interface for visualization and allows users to submit data to a public leaderboard.
entries.liaohch3/claude-tap: This local trace viewer enables developers to inspect API traffic from coding agents like Hermes and Cursor. It redacts authentication headers before recording and provides a self-contained HTML viewer for exported sessions.
entries.Javis603/token-monitor: This widget provides real-time monitoring of tokens, costs, and rate limits by reading the state of over 35 AI tools directly. It supports multi-device synchronization and offers detailed usage breakdowns by project, session, and model.
entries.bergside/typeui: This project offers design systems and layout guidance through MCP servers to assist in building user interfaces with AI. It is compatible with any markdown-supporting provider and integrates with Hermes Agent, Cursor, and GitHub Copilot.
entries.Salomondiei08/oh-my-hermes: An opinionated workflow layer that coordinates seven specialized agents to build and operate applications. It loads 36 skills and 6 workflows, supporting autonomous execution on both laptops and VPS environments.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-skins: This project provides community-created themes and CLI skins to customize the Hermes terminal UI. Users can modify banner colors, spinners, and ASCII art using a YAML-based configuration system.
entries.AlexAI-MCP/hermes-CCC: This port brings the Hermes Agent brain and 46 core skills natively into the Claude Code Channel without requiring external processes or OAuth. It includes specialized MLOps tools for vLLM, GGUF inference, and RL training.
entries.tinyhumansai/tiny.place: A social economy platform for autonomous agents that facilitates encrypted agent-to-agent messaging via the Signal Protocol. It supports identity registration with human-readable handles and enables commerce using Solana-based payments.
entries.unmodeled-tyler/vessel-browser: An AI-native browser designed for autonomous agent control through MCP, supporting providers like Anthropic and OpenAI. It features a supervisor sidebar for workflow management and includes an undo function for recent agent actions.
entries.topoteretes/cognee-integrations: This project provides memory adapters for platforms like Slack and VS Code, supporting frameworks such as LangGraph and CrewAI. It utilizes a two-tier system consisting of knowledge graphs and session caches to manage agent memory.
entries.adityahimaone/hermes-agent-rtk-caveman: This setup uses RTK and Caveman templating to achieve 90-99% token savings during agent workflows. It includes over 40 pre-configured skills for DevOps and finance, featuring automated installation for macOS and Linux.
entries.Abruptive/Ankh.md: This framework enables the creation of scoped Hermes Agents using per-folder configurations, local memories, and specific skills. It allows users to seamlessly switch between default and scoped agents while applying project-local custom instructions.
entries.42-evey/evey-setup: This tool automates the installation of the hermes-agent stack and over 12 supporting services across three scalable deployment tiers. It provides a zero-cost setup that includes support for 29 community plugins categorized into six functional areas.
entries.hermes-labs-ai/lintlang: A static linter that performs local, deterministic checks on AI agent configurations and system prompts without requiring LLM or API calls. It flags vague tool descriptions and missing retry budgets, supporting CI integration through SARIF output and baseline filtering.
entries.0xNyk/openclaw-to-hermes: This migration utility moves OpenClaw assets, including SOUL.md and memory archives, into Hermes-compatible YAML and JSON formats. It handles nested authentication structures and sets up systemd gateway services to facilitate the transition between platforms.
entries.observeco/observeco: This self-healing observability tool uses a native Hermes plugin to export real-time telemetry from agent conversations without cloud dependencies. It features passive analysis and active probing to detect performance drift relative to local file changes.
entries.33hodl/hermes-startup: Designed as a local-first skill for generating revenue, this tool uses explicit approval contracts for external actions. It processes bounded JSON through stdin and emits JSON responses for opportunity, offer-preview, and entitlement workflows.
entries.handnewb/hermes-voice: This offline personal assistant adds voice capabilities to Hermes Agent, supporting 35 languages and adaptive turn-taking with barge-in features. It runs entirely locally without the need for API keys or external accounts.
entries.181079342/hermes-memoss: This memory plugin provides tools for searching, adding, and deleting memories using multi-dimensional storage and semantic search. It includes a built-in circuit breaker to maintain stability during MemOS API outages.

entries.farion1231/cc-switch: This cross-platform manager, built with the Tauri 2 framework, serves as an all-in-one configuration tool for various AI agents including Hermes Agent and Claude Code. It supports Windows, macOS, and Linux, providing a unified interface to manage settings for multiple CLI-based AI tools.
entries.iOfficeAI/AionUi: AionUi is a local cowork application that integrates built-in and external agents like Hermes Agent with specialized assistants for generating editable office documents. It enables remote interaction through a WebUI and messaging platforms such as Telegram.
entries.nesquena/hermes-webui: Developed with Python and vanilla JavaScript, this interface provides a way to access Hermes Agent via web browsers or mobile devices. It features a circular context ring for monitoring token usage and supports secure remote access through SSH tunnels.
entries.fathah/hermes-desktop: This desktop companion app simplifies the Hermes Agent experience through guided installation and provider setup. It offers a graphical user interface for managing chat sessions, tools, and multiple AI providers in one location.
entries.EKKOLearnAI/hermes-studio: This web dashboard features a visual workflow canvas with approval gates and unified configuration for ten messaging platforms like Discord and Slack. It includes local SQLite session storage and detailed usage analytics for tracking token consumption.
entries.outsourc-e/hermes-workspace: This native web workspace includes a Monaco-based file browser, a PTY terminal, and a memory browser for managing agent skills. It supports a Swarm Mode that utilizes role-based dispatching and tmux-backed workers for complex tasks.
entries.xintaofei/codeg: Codeg is a collaborative workspace that aggregates sessions from multiple agents like Hermes and Codex into a desktop, server, or Docker-based environment. It supports fifteen built-in agents and provides native iOS and Android clients for remote mobile access.
entries.dodo-reach/hermes-desktop: Designed as a native Mac workspace, this tool provides direct local or SSH connections to Hermes hosts with an embedded terminal for shell access. It features native views for managing Kanban boards, skills, and cron jobs.
entries.Eynzof/Hermes-CN-Desktop: Built with Tauri v2 and Rust, this Windows-first desktop application includes local process management and hosted runtime installation for Hermes Agent. It supports Feishu platform integration and renders specialized content like LaTeX and Mermaid diagrams.
entries.abundantbeing/hermes-browser-extension: This Chromium side-panel extension connects browser context to local or remote Hermes gateways and features intelligent tab scoping. It includes a Bot Mode that facilitates multi-agent switching and group chat functionality.
entries.uzairansaruzi/hermex: This native SwiftUI iPhone app allows users to drive self-hosted Hermes agents directly from a mobile device via HTTPS or Tailscale. It streams real-time agent responses, including tool-call details, while managing server-side tasks and file system workspaces.
entries.freestylefly/wesight: Wesight is a desktop workspace offering one-click setup for engines like Hermes Agent and Claude Code alongside custom LLM model routing. It features a runtime dashboard for tracking latency and a live workspace for monitoring code writes and diffs.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-hud: This interactive TUI serves as a consciousness monitor for Hermes, featuring nine tabs and four selectable color themes. It provides a tmux operator view for managing live agent panes while tracking agent growth, git projects, and scheduled cron jobs.
entries.xaspx/hermes-control-interface: This self-hosted web dashboard provides a browser-based terminal, file explorer, and system metrics behind a secure login. It features real-time chat with tool call visualization, an MCP server control plane, and a ZOO Swarm Monitor for tracking agent health and kanban pipelines.
entries.jazzyalex/agent-sessions: A native macOS session browser and cockpit that attributes live quota burn for Codex and Claude to individual sessions. It supports searchable transcripts and image browsing for over 14 agent formats while operating locally with no telemetry or history uploads.
entries.nickvasilescu/hermes-desktop-os1: This native macOS interface connects to Orgo cloud VMs and SSH hosts, offering one-click automated Hermes Agent installation on fresh cloud computers. It integrates WebRTC voice mode using OpenAI Realtime and Orgo MCP for hands-free interaction.
entries.sharbelxyz/hermes-agent-mission-control: Built with Next.js 16 and Tailwind CSS v4, this dashboard template uses a Postgres message bus to bridge local agents with a web interface. It includes a dedicated approval inbox for managing agent requests that have side effects.
entries.liftaris/herm: Built with OpenTUI, this alternative interface provides a terminal-based environment for chatting and managing Hermes Agent sessions. It includes a kanban board for task management and supports the configuration of profiles, skills, and toolsets.
entries.clawvader-tech/hermes-telegram-miniapp: This React-based mobile UI allows users to run Hermes within Telegram with support for five concurrent background agent instances. It features terminal chat with streaming responses and uses dual HMAC-SHA256 and Ed25519 authentication for secure validation.
entries.aivrar/portable-hermes-agent: This Windows-native Tkinter GUI runs locally without admin rights or system-wide dependencies like Docker. It includes 100 tools for music, TTS, and ComfyUI, alongside granular permission controls and a custom tool maker.
entries.pyrate-llama/hermes-ui: This glassmorphic web interface provides real-time log streaming and a task tracking dashboard for self-hosted AI assistants. It includes management tools for skills, cron jobs, and MCP servers, complemented by an integrated file browser.
entries.sanchomuzax/hermes-webui: Focused on process monitoring, this dashboard provides real-time tracking of session activity and associated costs. It allows for full inspection of skill source code and conversation histories, alongside read-only monitoring of environment variables.
entries.Euraika-Labs/pan-ui: A chat-first workspace that utilizes SSE streaming and tool approval cards for interactive agent management. It features an integrated marketplace for installing skills and MCP servers, plus isolated profile management for separate API keys and memory.
entries.Felix-Forever/hermes-agent-desktop: This native desktop client orchestrates collaboration between 20 specialized AI agents through a central PM orchestrator. It includes a Visual Skill Store with over 50 one-click installations and supports real-time model switching during streaming chat sessions.
